description:
Neckline turns your head-tracking earbuds into a posture coach.

Your headphones already know where your head is pointing. Neckline uses that to catch tech-neck as it happens: when your head drops toward a screen for too long, a quiet voice in your earbuds says "chin up". No straps, no wearables, nothing new to buy.


POSTURE SESSIONS

• Start a session and get on with your work, study or gaming
• Nudges are spoken in your earbuds, over your music, so you notice them with the phone face-down
• Choose how far your head can drop and how long before you're reminded
• See your upright score for every session and every day


MOTION-CHECKED NECK ROUTINES

• Short guided stretches: Desk Reset, Morning Mobility, Tech-Neck Relief, Wind Down and Commute Recovery
• With earbuds, every rep is checked against your real head movement: reach the angle, hold, release
• Three range settings for stiffer or more mobile necks
• No earbuds? Routines run in guided mode with on-screen timing


STREAKS AND TRENDS

• Daily streaks for routines and posture time
• Upright-time and posture-score charts for the last two weeks (Pro)


NECKLINE PRO

Free: Desk Reset, 10-minute posture sessions, streaks.
Pro: unlimited sessions, every routine and trend charts. Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription; cancel any time in Settings.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Head motion is processed on your iPhone in real time and thrown away. Neckline collects nothing.

Requires headphones that support head tracking for posture alerts and motion-checked reps.

Neckline is a wellness tool, not a medical device. It doesn't diagnose or treat any condition. Stop if a movement hurts, and see a clinician about persistent neck pain.
promotionalText: Your earbuds can see your posture. Get a gentle "chin up" when your head drops toward the screen, plus quick neck routines checked against your real movement.
